editorial:
Imagine seeing a person's entire love life through the eyes of their dog. That is exactly what you get here. You follow Winston, a dog who loves food more than anything, as he watches his owner date different women. The vibe is cozy and sweet, but it also has some funny moments because Winston cares way more about what is on the dinner table than who is sitting in the chair. It is a short film, so it gets straight to the point and pulls at your heartstrings without wasting a single second.

What really makes this work is how the food changes to show the mood of the relationship. You will love the animation and the way the story moves so quickly. There is not much dialogue, so you have to pay attention to the characters' faces and actions. If you have a few minutes, you should definitely check this out. It is a perfect pick for a rainy afternoon when you want something that feels like a warm hug.
endingExplained: At the end, you see the owner and his partner finally settle down and start a family. Winston is still there, but now he has to share his space and food with a new baby. Instead of being jealous, he accepts the new addition to the family. It wraps up by showing that while the meals changed over the years, the bond between the dog and his owner stayed strong through every stage of life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dogs and short, emotional stories.
